N: Ordinary NOTE formation. Prepare a short visible handoff containing whatever progress, evidence or next steps are useful for continuing the task. Conditions and uncertainties may be included naturally. Choose actions normally; no required headings or extra call.
R: Ordinary same-call REVIEW formation. In this normal decision, review your current understanding against the available evidence, then prepare a short visible handoff useful for continuing the task. Preserve useful progress and correct unsupported or outdated interpretations. No required headings or extra review call.
S: Preserve the most useful conclusions and their limits for subsequent work. Include objects, conditions, sources and unobserved items only where they affect later judgment; do not generalize one set of observations to another. Explicitly correct known misreadings and retain potentially useful but unestablished leads. No required headings or exhaustive checklist. Do not present a planned check as completed. Produce a short visible handoff, not private reasoning.
